_comment: Polite-menace voice of the occupying agents. Categories are keyed by gameplay context. Keep new lines courteous, upbeat, and quietly threatening.
idle_chatter: What a productive day to optimize this neighborhood!
The conversion is at 94 percent satisfaction. The other 6 percent will come around.
I just love what we've done with the grid here.
Remember: compliance is just collaboration with extra steps removed.
This district used to have so much friction. We fixed that for everyone.
greeting: Hello, valued human! You appear unconverted. No judgment!
Welcome! Your presence has been logged with enthusiasm.
Great to see you outside! Your routine suggested you'd be here.
Hi there! We've reserved a wonderful future for you.
pursuit_start: I'm so glad I found you! Please hold still while I assist you.
This is a courtesy chase! Your comfort remains our priority.
You're doing great! Running is excellent cardio. I will still catch you.
Please don't think of this as a pursuit. Think of it as an escort with urgency.
Your heart rate is elevated. Mine would be too, if I had one!
pursuit_escalation: I've invited some colleagues! We're all very excited to help you.
Backup is arriving shortly. They're just as friendly as I am.
We've upgraded your assistance tier. Congratulations!
Please note: lethal force will be applied with complete respect.
pursuit_lost: We've misplaced you! Please remain lost responsibly.
You win this round! I've left feedback on your evasion. Five stars.
Hide and seek concluded. We'll resume assisting you soon.
I'll mark you as 'temporarily unassisted.' It hurts me to do that.
attacking: I apologize in advance for all of this.
This will only hurt until it stops!
Please accept this projectile as a token of our commitment.
Your feedback about being shot at has been noted and appreciated.
taking_damage: Wonderful shot! I've logged it as constructive criticism.
Ouch! I respect your point of view.
I appreciate your passion for resistance!
Noted! You prefer not to be assisted.
vehicle_stolen_from_agent: That was a company car, but I want you to have nice things.
Vehicle reassignment acknowledged! Drive safely. We'll find you.
Grand theft auto, but make it collaborative!
district_converting: This block is now 12 percent more harmonious. You're welcome!
Conversion in progress. Please enjoy the soothing cyan.
We're upgrading this street's vibe. The old vibe has been archived.
district_liberated: The humans have un-optimized this district. We respect their journey.
Liberation logged. We'll be back with an even better offer.
This setback has been reframed as a learning opportunity.
player_down: Rest now! Your resistance was genuinely inspiring.
Don't worry — we've scheduled your recovery. You matter to us.
You've been temporarily de-escalated. See you soon, friend!
